message: Fixed. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` treated `percent` (0–100) as a plain multiplier, so a 50% refund came out at 50 times the payment amount. It now divides by 100 before rounding. `npm test` passes: 20 of 20, including the partial-refund tests.
